name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
November 12, 2024
7:00
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1-7)
1.
APPROVAL OF WARRANTS
Recommendation: Review and Approve Warrant Register of November 12, 2024.
Warrants
2.
RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE PERIOD ENDING OCTOBER 31, 2024
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the financial statements for the month ending October 31, 2024
Staff Report
3.
CITY COUNCIL MEETING ACTIONS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the minutes for the following meetings: September 10, 2024 and September 24, 2024.
Minutes
Revised Attachments
4.
FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING ACTIONS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the meeting minutes for the November 4, 2024 Special Finance Advisory Committee Meeting.
Minutes
5.
APPROVE AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT FOR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES BETWEEN THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AND
JANA FRAZIER CONSULTING
Recommendation: That the City Council authorize the Mayor to sign the third Amendment to the Contract for Professional Services between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and Jana Frazier Consulting in order to increase the not-to-exceed amount from $100,000 to $125,000.
Staff Report
6.
AMENDED AND RESTATED CONCESSION AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AND THE PALOS VERDES
GOLF CLUB
Recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to execute the proposed Amended and Restated Concession Agreement (Attachment A) between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Golf Club.
Staff Report
Additional Documents
7.
CONSIDER AND APPROVE PALOS VERDES GOLF CLUB 2024 PROPOSED BUDGET
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council Approve the Palos Verdes Golf Club's (PVGC) proposed operating and capital budgets and the proposed schedule of dues and fees as submitted by the PVGC.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
8.
MALAGA COVE STATUS INTRUSION AND SUBSURFACE INVESTIGATION
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive an update on the Malaga Lane water intrusion and subsurface investigation and provide directions to staff.
Staff Report
9.
RESOLUTION TO AWARD A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT TO WOOD RODGERS, INC. FOR THE CITYWIDE DRAINAGE MASTER PLAN, IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $520,885, WHICH INCLUDES THE BASE PROPOSAL OF $495,885 PLUS $25,000 FOR ADDITIONAL PROJECT EXPENDITURES (CONTINGENCY), WHICH IS APPROXIMATELY 5% OF CONTRACT AMOUNT OF $495,885; APPROPRIATE $121,000 NEEDED FOR DESIGN, PROJECT MANAGEMENT AND CONTINGENCY, FROM UNENCUMBERED GENERAL FUND FOR CAPITAL PROJECTS; AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE ALL CONTRACT DOCUMENTS IN FINAL FORM AND FORMAT AS APPROVVED BY THE CITY ATTORNEY.
Recommendation: That the City Council adopt the Resolution to:
1. Award a professional services agreement to Wood Rodgers, Inc. for the Citywide Drainage Master Plan (City Project No. PW-705-23). in the amount not to exceed $520,885, which includes the base proposal of $495,885 plus $25,000 for additional project expenditures (contingency), which is approximately 5% of the contract amount of $495,885; and
2. Appropriate $121,000 needed for design, project management and contingency from unencumbered General Fund for Capital Projects; and
3. Authorize the City Manager to execute all contract documents in final form and format as approved by the City Attorney.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
10.
RECEIVE A REPORT ON POTENTIAL IMMEDIATE DRAINAGE PROJECT NEEDS AND PROVIDE FURTHER DIRECTION
Recommendation: That the City Council adopt the Resolution to:
1. Receive a report on citywide drainage repair needs; and
2. Provide further direction to staff
Staff Report
MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, reports on community activities, ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
TENTATIVE FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
Tentative Future Agenda Items
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 26, 2024, AT 6:30 P.M.
